# Application Domain - Kubernetes Workload Patterns

**← Back to [EAP Home](../../../README.md) • [Patterns](../../README.md) • [Application](../README.md)**

This directory contains application-level patterns for Kubernetes workload configuration within the **Application Domain**. These patterns focus on how applications are deployed, configured, and managed as Kubernetes workloads.
page_texts.2:
[patterns/application/kubernetes/README.md#overview]

## Overview

Kubernetes Workload patterns address:

- **Deployment Configurations**: How applications are deployed to Kubernetes
- **Workload Types**: StatefulSets, Deployments, Jobs, CronJobs
- **Application Configuration**: ConfigMaps, Secrets, environment variables
- **Resource Management**: CPU/memory requests and limits
- **Health & Lifecycle**: Liveness, readiness, startup probes
